audit_metadata.audit_name: Phase 8.2.1 Decision-Threshold and FER Safety Policy Forensic Audit
audit_metadata.preservation_status: Phase 1-8 Historical Results and Phase 8.2 Artifacts 100% Preserved

forensic_classification.original_tau_meaning: Accidental transcription of FER <= 15% safety limit into classifier threshold field

eleven_forensic_questions.q1_tau_code_meaning: In code (src/phase8_separated/phase8_separated_models.py:L133), tau is the binary emergency decision boundary: is_emergency = probs >= tau. In config/phase8_2/confirmation_protocol.yaml, tau=0.1500 was an accidental textual copy of the 15% FER safety limit.
eleven_forensic_questions.q2_score_scale_comparison: tau is compared to calibrated or bounded emergency probabilities in [0.0, 1.0], not unconstrained raw logits.
eleven_forensic_questions.q3_definition_and_consumption: Defined in config/phase8_2/confirmation_protocol.yaml (L11, L16, L21, L26, L31, L36) and scripts/phase8_2/generate_phase8_2_readiness_artifacts.py (L205). Consumed only by readiness test tests/phase8_2/test_phase8_2_readiness.py:L84. Never consumed in inference.
eleven_forensic_questions.q4_provenance_source: COPIED FROM FER LIMIT. Phase 8.1 search grid was np.arange(0.40, 0.90, 0.05). tau=0.1500 was never in the search grid, never calibrated, and never selected.
eleven_forensic_questions.q5_candidate_model_version: Belongs to NO MODEL. It was uniformly copied across all 6 candidate models (Track A, INT-1, INT-2, INT-3, Track B, Track C) without model-specific derivation.
eleven_forensic_questions.q6_scope_specificity: Written as a flat global scalar in Phase 8.2 YAML, whereas actual Phase 8.1 thresholds in results/phase8_1/threshold_registry.json are fold-specific and speaker-specific (mean=0.762, range [0.40, 0.85]).
eleven_forensic_questions.q7_score_calibration: Track A, Track B, Track C used uncalibrated ensemble averages; INT-1 used Platt logistic scaling; INT-2 used cost-reweighting; INT-3 used balanced oversampling.
eleven_forensic_questions.q8_phase8_1_comparison: Phase 8.1 thresholds in threshold_registry.json average 0.762 (0.745 Track A, 0.728 Track B, 0.733 Track C). In safety_operating_points.csv, pooled feasible threshold is tau=0.60. None are comparable to 0.1500.
eleven_forensic_questions.q9_oof_traceability: YES. Phase 8.1 nested inner-CV selected thresholds strictly on inner OOF predictions without fitting on those samples, completely documented in results/phase8_1/threshold_registry.json.
eleven_forensic_questions.q10_effect_of_changing_tau: Changing tau affects ONLY the classifier operating point (Recall vs FER). It DOES NOT alter the FER safety bound itself, which is an independent policy constraint (FER <= 15.0%).
eleven_forensic_questions.q11_test_data_leakage: NO. The locked 20% test partition was quarantined as diagnostic-only in Phase 8.1. The error was purely a textual conflation of the policy limit.

empirical_operating_point_analysis.consequence_at_tau_0_15: At tau=0.20, FER is 82.32% (Track A) and 83.84% (Track B). At tau=0.1500, FER > 90%, causing catastrophic false alarms (over 900 false alarms per 1,000 utterances).

separate_fields.decision_policy: Explicit model-specific score_name, comparator, and development operating points
separate_fields.safety_constraints: Explicit canonical FER metric definition, formula, fraction 0.1500, percent 15.0%
